2609.10018.title: Elastoformer: Enabling Dynamic Adaptivity via Elastic Model Transformation
2609.10018.paper_summary: EdgeAI systems are increasingly employing computer vision applications to enable intelligent, on-device decision-making in real-time. However, these deployments face highly dynamic operational conditions, with fluctuating constraints on latency, power availability, and memory resources. Deep Neural Networks (DNN), which follow fixed computational execution flows, lack the flexibility to adapt to such variability, resulting in inefficient and suboptimal performance in edge scenarios. This underscores the need for architectures that are not only efficient but also dynamically scalable at runtime. In this paper, we propose Elastoformer: A framework that transforms conventional neural networks (NN) into Elastic NN capable of real-time elastic inference. Unlike the conventional bag-of-models approach, which requires maintaining multiple independent models for different operating conditions, Elastoformer offers a single, modular solution that dynamically switches between multiple modes of operation at runtime, adapting efficiently to the changing computational budgets of edge devices without the overhead of managing separate models. Experiments reveal that our framework achieves up to 85% reduction in computation FLOPs, 50% reduction in latency and 76% reduction in memory overhead, while showcasing the architecture agnostic nature of the framework across both Vision Transformers and CNNs. Our code is available at https://github.com/sudaksh14/Elastoformer.
2609.10018.paper_summary_zh: 邊緣AI系統越來越多地使用計算機視覺應用，以實現實時的智能設備內決策。<lb/>然而，這些部署面臨高度動態的操作條件，延遲、電源可用性和內存資源的約束不斷波動。<lb/>深度神經網絡（DNN）遵循固定的計算執行流程，缺乏適應這種變化的靈活性，導致在邊緣場景中效率低下和性能不佳。<lb/>這凸顯了需要不僅高效而且在運行時動態可擴展的架構。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了Elastoformer：一個將傳統神經網絡（NN）轉變為能夠實時彈性推斷的彈性NN的框架。<lb/>與傳統的模型包方法不同，該方法需要為不同的操作條件維護多個獨立模型，Elastoformer提供了一個單一的模塊化解決方案，能夠在運行時動態切換多種操作模式，有效地適應邊緣設備不斷變化的計算預算，而無需管理單獨模型的開銷。<lb/>實驗顯示，我們的框架在計算FLOPs上實現了高達85%的減少，在延遲上減少了50%，在內存開銷上減少了76%，同時展示了該框架在視覺Transformer和CNN之間的架構無關性。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/sudaksh14/Elastoformer 獲得。
